About This Free Download
This guide brings together 100 of the most widely used healing frequencies across modern and traditional sound healing systems, including Solfeggio, Brainwave, Tesla, Angelic, Planetary, Meridian, Rife, and Special Frequencies. Each frequency resonates with specific aspects of the body, mind, and spirit, supporting grounding, emotional release, energetic balance, and spiritual awakening.​
​
​
🎁
What You Will Receive
​
Part 1 – “100 Frequencies for Healing” PDF Guide
A beautifully organized reference that lists
all 100 frequencies and their benefits
, helping you identify the tones that align with your personal goals for balance and transformation.
​
Part 2 – 8-Day Email Tutorials and Frequency Music
After downloading the guide, you will receive one email per day for 8 days. Each day focuses on a different frequency system and includes clear guidance, a free music track, and simple practices to help you apply the frequencies in daily life.
​
Together, they create a complete learning and listening experience that deepens your understanding of sound healing and its real effects on mind, body, and spirit.

Meet Your Instructor
Narek Mirzaei is the founder of Music of Wisdom and a composer with over a decade of experience creating music for meditation, wellness, and healing. His work integrates ancient wisdom with modern sound science, exploring how frequencies can restore balance to the mind and body.
​
Narek has collaborated with more than 25 global meditation and healing brands, including the BetterSleep app (with over 65 million users), Envol, Superhuman, and the Nature Healing Society. His music is also used by over 25,000 teachers and practitioners worldwide in classes, workshops, and personal practices.
​
The Healing Frequencies Program is the culmination of his ten years of hands-on experience — a carefully crafted journey designed to help learners understand and experience the true power of sound and vibration.
